plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction mandatory T&C acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to a reverse auction using the default rank strategy.
Provide the required event title for publishing.
Select a reverse or buy auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested product as the first line with quantity 10.
Set the first line's delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001).

args.goal: On the single-stage create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen showing both clauses as mandatory or overridden by Mark all mandatory.

steps.note: Configure the two clauses and mark them mandatory; no dedicated catalog step exposes this Terms & Conditions editor.
Add one QA test vendor for Vendor A's participation.
Commit the immediate 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Have the vendor accept the first mandatory clause.
Have the vendor accept the second mandatory clause.
Quote 100 for every line and submit after accepting both clauses.
Verify that the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Verify that the buyer sees the vendor response.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer-side confirmation that bidding vendors accepted the Terms and Conditions.
